meta.title: Master QCS of a Tech+RFQ project
gaps: The technical result displayed beside each commercial price, including the technically rejected vendor marker
That a technically rejected vendor cannot be awarded
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The technical result displayed beside each commercial price, including the technically rejected vendor marker; That a technically rejected vendor cannot be awarded

steps.note: Open the existing prepared Tech+RFQ project from the buyer summary page.
Navigate to the project's Master QCS comparison screen.
Assert that the Master QCS comparison grid renders with its line items and bidding vendor.
Verify the vendor column is present and uses a real vendor name.
Verify the commercial price shown in Master QCS matches the prepared bid.
Verify the commercial line amount and total are calculated correctly from the bid and quantity.
